Maria Thompson: All-hands in 18m. Quick AV heads-up — during rehearsal OBS dropped a scene when encoder CPU hit 95%. We're switching to the backup ingest (rtmp://backup.redwood.tv/live). Need a camera operator to flip to the static wide cam and someone to monitor live captions. @Aj can you handle camera? @Devin can you stand by for captions and recordings?
Aj Patel: On it. Swapping to Sony-A7S wide now. Notify me if audio levels spike. I'll also toggle NDI fallback if feed dies. :thumbsup:
Devin Chen: I'll watch captions. If the speech-to-text stalls, switch to manual captions feed at /manual-captions. Also copying rtmp health logs:```
[ffmpeg] frame_drop=3 cpu=95% rtmp_reconnects=1
[ingest] last_push=23s_ago latency=420ms
```
Ellie Gomez: I'll do recorder checks — disk space is at 58% on recorder2. Re-encoding to 4k may be heavy, keep it 1080p.
Sanjay Rao: Heads-up for leadership Q&A — if someone asks about Dedicated vs Private roadmap, use the wording from slide 12: 'unified runtime across environments'. Also, leadership will take live prompts only, funnel other qs to #all-hands-followup.
Maria Thompson: Thanks. @OpsBot can you bump stream health alerts to critical if ingest flaps >2 times in 5m?
OpsBot: Alert rule updated: ingest_flaps threshold=2 window=300s. Will escalate to infra on call. :mechanical_arm:
OBS-bot: Scene auto-switch to backup engaged. New ingest: rtmp://backup.redwood.tv/live liveKey=AHX-23
Aj Patel: Switched to wide cam, audio looks normal. Manual captions standby link: https://docs.redwood.dev/manual-captions
Devin Chen: Caption stream had a 4s lag during test; toggled low-latency mode. Watching.
Ellie Gomez: Recorder2: started new file allhands_2026-03-23_01.mp4. Disk OK.
Maria Thompson: OK team — if stream stable at +5m we'll keep main timeline; if not, fallback to slide-only and record Q&A audio separately. Leadership, be prepared for 2-min mic handoff between speakers.
Sanjay Rao: noted. Also will field 3 live questions: infra pricing, Dedicated capacity SLA, roadmap timing. We'll confirm answers offline for follow-ups.
Devin Chen: Quick note for devs tuning prompts: don't reference internal model names on screen; use 'Redwood-managed model' for public demos.
Maria Thompson: Perfect. Everyone, thumbs up if ready.
Aj Patel: :thumbsup: 
Devin Chen: :+1: 
Ellie Gomez: :white_check_mark:
